name: AI Steel Thread — Loan Approval
title: AI Steel Thread — Loan Approval
description: CALM architecture for the FINOS Fluxnova AI Steel Thread demo implementing the FINOS AI Governance Framework UC-3 Loan Approval use case. Captures the Spring Boot host, Fluxnova engine surfaces, agentic ad-hoc subprocess runtime, external-task workers, Spring AI / OpenAI provider and models, launch UI, and local observability stack.

metadata.note: BPMN is deployed from Fluxnova Modeler (not versioned in this repo). Credit-risk agent provider/model are declared on AgentTask_CreditRisk via agent:config and resolved at runtime by AgentProviderRegistry → SpringAiLlmService. mi-1 AI data-leakage controls are attached to OpenAI boundary nodes/edges and the LLM callers; architecture controls declare policy intent and do not by themselves enforce runtime DLP. mi-4 AI system observability controls are attached to LLM callers and the observability stack; runtime metrics/audit live in org.finos.ai.demo.observability. mi-5 system acceptance testing is attached to the demo API and AI decision paths; runtime suite lives in org.finos.ai.demo.acceptance. mi-11 human feedback is attached to the demo API, launch UI, Cockpit, and loan-officer actor; runtime lives in org.finos.ai.demo.feedback and completes the existing BPMN user task.

flows.name: Start Loan Approval Instance
flows.description: Loan officer launches a LoanApprovalProcess_AI instance with amount, purpose, and sample identity document

transitions.description: Officer opens Launch UI and submits the loan form
UI POSTs /api/demo/loan-approval/start
Demo service starts process definition LoanApprovalProcess_AI with attachedFile and form variables
Engine persists the new process instance

flows.name: Document Intelligence Extraction
flows.description: External-task worker extracts identity fields from the attached document via OpenAI gpt-5.4

transitions.description: External-task client fetches document-intelligence topic
Client dispatches ExtractDataFromDocumentWorker
Worker calls DocumentIntelligenceService
Spring AI sends structured chat request to OpenAI
OpenAI serves model gpt-5.4 and returns extraction + token usage

flows.name: Credit Risk Agent Tool Loop
flows.description: Agentic ad-hoc subprocess AgentTask_CreditRisk plans and invokes credit tools via OpenAI, with deterministic policy gates

transitions.description: Engine schedules an agent job for AgentTask_CreditRisk
Job executor enters the credit-risk agent scope
Agentic plugin loads agent:config, tools, and context
Plugin requests an LLM turn
Provider registry selects the openai ChatModel
Spring AI calls OpenAI Chat Completions
Configured BPMN model (typically gpt-5.4) returns tool calls / final answer
Agent dispatches check-credit-score, verify-employment, and/or evaluate-credit-risk tools

flows.name: Observe Process Run
flows.description: Operators inspect instance status in the UI and deeper traces/metrics in Grafana

transitions.description: UI polls /instances/{id}/status for activity log and LLM tokens
Runtime exports spans to Tempo
Prometheus scrapes LLM and task metrics
Grafana renders Fluxnova dashboards
